project.title: HydroSentinel AI
project.summary: A flash flood early warning system that predicts flood severity for mountain valleys from rainfall, soil moisture, river gauge and terrain data.
project.stat_1_label: R² score of the flood severity model
project.overview: HydroSentinel AI combines satellite rainfall, IoT soil moisture, river gauge and terrain data, turns them into hydrological features such as the Topographic Wetness Index, and trains ensemble models to predict a Flash Flood Severity Index. The predictions feed a Flask API and a live dashboard with a 3D terrain view, real-time telemetry, colour-coded evacuation alerts and a scenario simulator.
